spanish: Y fue cien talento de la plata para fundir las basas del santo y las basas de la parójet; cien basas a cien el talento, talento a la basa.

findings.issue: הַפָּרֹכֶת is a common noun (veil/curtain), not a name; “parójet” leaves the lemma untranslated.
לִמְאַת הַכִּכָּר is “for the hundred of the talent”; “a cien el talento” does not mark that construct.
הַקֹּדֶשׁ is the masculine noun holiness/holy thing; “del santo” can be read as a holy person.

notes: Remaining clauses keep the wayyiqtol, the hundred-talent construct with the silver, the qal infinitive, both plural socket chains, and singular talent-per-socket.
